host: Chea Sim Santhormok High School, Phnom Penh
note: Official MoEYS decree (prakas) of 16 May 2024, signed by Minister Hang Chuon Naron; photographed pages published by Kampuchea Thmey. First year with 5 ranks per subject (30 honourees from 240 finalists). Cash prizes 3.5M to 2.3M riel for ranks 1–5; medals for ranks 1–3.
